newsitem.title: USA: Micron says chip inventory declining.
newsitem.headline: Micron says chip inventory declining.

text.p: Micron Technology Inc's inventory of computer memory chips has declined in recent weeks amid higher orders from personal computer makers, said Kipp Bedard, vice president of corporate affairs.
The stock of dynamic random access memory chips in recent days was four million units, compared with 10 million on August 31, Bedard said.
"Inventory levels look good," Bedard told investors at the Montgomery Securities Investment Conference. He declined to comment about contract memory prices in coming weeks.
